scope: Source-backed visual paraphrases fixed before description experiment scoring. No benchmark photos or image-level labels were consulted to write these descriptions. Sex, age and seasonal alternatives are encoded separately; they are not assumed simultaneously visible. Sources accessed 2026-09-28.

species.name: Pied Kingfisher
descriptions: A Pied Kingfisher with contrasting black and white plumage, a bushy crest and a dark pointed bill.
A Pied Kingfisher showing bold dark markings across its pale head and breast, and a short crest.

species.name: Belted Kingfisher
descriptions: A Belted Kingfisher with a shaggy crest, large head, thick pointed bill, blue-gray back and a blue band across its white breast.
A female Belted Kingfisher with blue-gray upperparts, a white underside, blue breast band and an additional rusty band across the belly.

species.name: Lazuli Bunting
descriptions: A male Lazuli Bunting with blue head and back, orange breast, white belly, pale shoulder patch and a short conical bill.
A female Lazuli Bunting with brown-gray upperparts, pale cinnamon breast, bluish wings and tail, and two buff wingbars.

species.name: Indigo Bunting
descriptions: A breeding male Indigo Bunting with blue plumage over the body, deeper blue head, short tail and a thick conical gray bill.
A female or young Indigo Bunting with brown plumage, whitish throat, faint breast streaks and occasional blue feathers in the wings or tail.

species.name: Ruby throated Hummingbird
descriptions: A male Ruby-throated Hummingbird with metallic green back, gray-white underparts, a thin bill and a red throat that can appear dark in shadow.
A female Ruby-throated Hummingbird with green upperparts, pale underside, slender bill and dark tail feathers with white outer tips.

species.name: Rufous Hummingbird
descriptions: A male Rufous Hummingbird with orange back and belly, white breast, iridescent reddish throat and a thin nearly straight bill.
A female or young Rufous Hummingbird with green upperparts, rusty sides and rusty patches in the tail, sometimes with an orange throat spot.

species.name: Northern Waterthrush
descriptions: A Northern Waterthrush with brown upperparts, buff-yellow underparts marked by dark streaks, and a narrow pale yellowish eyebrow.
A Northern Waterthrush with a fine short bill, short tail, long dusky legs and a pale eyebrow that remains narrow behind the eye.

species.name: Louisiana Waterthrush
descriptions: A Louisiana Waterthrush with brown back, pale streaked underside and a broad white eyebrow widening behind the eye.
A Louisiana Waterthrush with long bright pink legs, a stout bill, short tail and prominent white eyebrow.

species.name: Brandt Cormorant
descriptions: A breeding Brandt's Cormorant with blackish plumage, blue eyes and throat skin, a buff throat border and wispy white feathers around the head and shoulders.
A nonbreeding Brandt's Cormorant with dark plumage, long neck, hooked bill tip and a pale brown chin patch; juveniles are browner.

species.name: Red faced Cormorant
descriptions: A breeding Red-faced Cormorant with glossy dark plumage, red bare face, pale yellowish bill and white flank patches.
A nonbreeding Red-faced Cormorant with dark plumage, a conspicuously pale bill and a long thick neck; juveniles are dark brown.

species.name: Forsters Tern
descriptions: A breeding Forster's Tern with gray back, white underside, black cap, orange legs and an orange bill ending in black.
A nonbreeding Forster's Tern with very pale plumage, white crown, broad dark eye patch, dark pointed bill and long tail streamers.

species.name: Black Tern
descriptions: A breeding Black Tern with dark gray back, black head and underside, and paler feathers beneath the wings and tail.
A nonbreeding Black Tern with gray upperparts, white underside, dark crown and ear patch, and a dark mark beside the breast.

species.name: Long tailed Jaeger
descriptions: A breeding Long-tailed Jaeger with a slender body, very long pointed tail streamers, brownish back, black cap and pale yellow sides of the neck.
A young Long-tailed Jaeger with slender wings, a short thick bill and scaly wing markings; plumage ranges from dark brown to pale gray.

species.name: Pomarine Jaeger
descriptions: A breeding Pomarine Jaeger with bulky body, broad wings, thick bill and elongated spoon-shaped central tail feathers, dark upperparts and white wing flashes.
A young Pomarine Jaeger with brown barred upperparts and bold pale and dark bars beneath the wings and tail; its wings are broad.

species.name: Pine Grosbeak
descriptions: A male Pine Grosbeak with pink-red and gray plumage, dark gray wings and two white wingbars.
A female or immature Pine Grosbeak with gray plumage, orange or yellow tones on the head and rump, and two white bars on dark wings.

species.name: Evening Grosbeak
descriptions: A male Evening Grosbeak with a very large pale conical bill, yellow and black body, dark head, yellow eyebrow and a white wing patch.
A female Evening Grosbeak with gray body, black and white wings, yellow-green neck and flanks, and a large pale conical bill.

species.name: Hooded Oriole
descriptions: A male Hooded Oriole with yellow-orange plumage, black face and throat, dark wings with white bars, long tail and slightly curved bill.
A female Hooded Oriole with olive-yellow plumage, grayish back, narrow white wingbars, slender body and long rounded tail.

species.name: Orchard Oriole
descriptions: An adult male Orchard Oriole with black head, throat and back, chestnut underside and a chestnut patch at the wing bend.
A female Orchard Oriole with green-yellow plumage and two white wingbars; a young male also has black around the bill and throat.

species.name: Black billed Cuckoo
descriptions: A Black-billed Cuckoo with brown upperparts, white underside, red eye ring and a long dark bill with a gentle curve.
A Black-billed Cuckoo with a slender body and long tail bearing small white tips; the wings are brown without strong rusty patches.

species.name: Yellow billed Cuckoo
descriptions: A Yellow-billed Cuckoo with brown back, white underside, mainly yellow bill, yellow eye ring and dark facial mask.
A Yellow-billed Cuckoo showing rusty outer wings and a long tail with broad white bands separated by narrower dark bands underneath.
